fix_ripgrep_tool_calls: fix ripgrep tool calls by stripping invalid -R flags from rg commands before execution
correct_hallucinated_tool_names: correct hallucinated tool name variations like exec or executor to the valid execute tool name
strip_invalid_ripgrep_flags: strip invalid -R flags from ripgrep commands in various positions including trailing and embedded
capture_ripgrep_commands: capture ripgrep commands for summary reporting by storing them on the runner object
apply_tool_name_corrections: apply predefined tool name corrections mapping incorrect names like execscript to execute
